summary: Iteration 75 - Kiosk Self Check-In, Welcome Info Settings, and SMS/WhatsApp Satisfaction Testing Complete. All 20 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI components verified working including kiosk page with welcome/search/results/register screens, Guest Journey panel with 4 tabs (Registrations, Satisfaction, Welcome Info, Kiosk Setup), and ID Upload with Take Photo/Choose from Gallery options.

issues: Hotel name shows 'Hotel' instead of actual property name - this is because the kiosk page fetches from /api/properties which requires auth. The property name lookup should use a public endpoint or be passed differently.

action_items: Minor: Kiosk welcome screen shows 'Hotel' instead of actual property name because /api/properties requires auth. Consider adding a public endpoint for property name lookup or passing property name via URL parameter.
critical_code_review_comments: Kiosk page well-implemented with 4 screens (welcome, search, results, register) and proper state management
Kiosk uses iframe to embed existing registration page - good code reuse
60-second idle timeout correctly resets to welcome screen
Welcome Info tab allows full customization of hotel policies, city info, and custom message
Kiosk Setup tab provides clear setup instructions with QR code for easy device setup
ID Upload step provides both camera capture and gallery selection options
All kiosk endpoints (lookup, register) are correctly public (no auth required)
Welcome info endpoints correctly require admin/manager authentication
SMS/WhatsApp satisfaction delivery gracefully skips when not configured
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test data from previous iterations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 75 tested new kiosk self check-in feature, welcome info settings, and SMS/WhatsApp satisfaction delivery. Kiosk page at /checkin-kiosk/{property_id} has 4 screens: welcome, search, results, register. Guest Journey panel now has 4 tabs: Registrations, Satisfaction, Welcome Info, Kiosk Setup. ID Upload step has Take Photo and Choose from Gallery options. All backend endpoints working. Minor issue: kiosk welcome screen shows 'Hotel' instead of property name because /api/properties requires auth.

mocked_apis.note: SMS (Twilio) and WhatsApp require API keys configured in channel_settings - they gracefully skip when not configured. Email uses Resend placeholder key (re_123456789).
